decisions.reason: It remained on the website in 2024, but as a less prominently presented manual laser product with some overlap to newer laser cabin offerings, it has a moderate rationalisation risk rather than an immediate exit risk.
The thermal inkjet printer had its own product page in both 2023 and 2024, which signals an established and still-supported position in the firm's coding and marking portfolio.
The piezo inkjet printer also kept a dedicated page across both years, suggesting continuing commercial relevance even if it serves a more specialised segment.
Being shown on the home page in 2024 indicates strategic importance and active promotion, so a withdrawal within a year is unlikely.
This compact laser marking cabin was explicitly launched as new in 2024 and given its own page, so management would normally allow more time to build sales before considering discontinuation.
Although only mentioned on the website, the lubricant printing system received a trade-fair award, which is a strong positive signal for keeping and further developing a niche industrial solution.
